messages:
Priya (Product): Quick daily async check-in — what I did / blockers / today. Drop short updates here and any asks.

Maria (Eng): What I did: merged inference-batching PR, started gradual rollout.
Blocker: seeing intermittent mem growth on p2; trying to get a repro on smaller dataset.
Today: will keep the rollout at 10% and open a bug with heap dump when reproduced.

Dan (Eng-runtime): What I did: pushed kv-cache eviction patch to staging and perf branch.
No blockers atm.
Today: running soak on dedicated infra, will post perf metrics. @Maria please watch latency dashboard (per-route).

Jared (SRE): What I did: updated autoscale policy for dedicated-prod and rolled to us-west-2/us-east-1.
Blocker: two nodes failed health checks during rollout, investigating underlying disk IO.
Today: draining and replacing nodes, coordinating with infra team.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for railgun-v2 on us-west-2 — 20% traffic. :rocket:

Luis (Eng-ML): What I did: ran quantization sweep for railgun-v2.
Blocker: observed ~4% score drop on long-context evals at 4-bit config. Need targeted prompts from research to triage.
Today: running ablation + higher-precision fallback candidate.

Priya (Product): @Luis please drop failing prompts in #eng-ml and tag me if it impacts our production evals. We'll prioritize a short rollback plan if needed.

Ava (DevEx): What I did: docs refresh for streaming SDK and examples.
Blocker: missing concise example for function-calling with nested objects.
Today: PR will be ready for review; will ping @Maria and @Dan for technical review.

Maria (Eng): Will review Ava's PR this afternoon.

Dan (Eng-runtime): Small ask for reviewers: when doing perf reviews, please run CI perf test and paste logs if flaky.
Quick command we use locally: `./tools/run_perf --model railgun-v2 --seq 1024`

Jared (SRE): FYI opened an incident thread in #incidents for the autoscale hiccup at 1835004900 — will update there with root-cause timeline.

Priya (Product): Thanks team — no other blockers from product. If you need support for prioritization, ping me directly. I'll add the autoscale incident to the all-hands agenda. :white_check_mark:
